svg.title: Differential drive nonholonomic and wheel-rate feasibility
svg.desc: Same circle footprint and fixed obstacle. A compares centerline with slow feasible reorientation and fast clipped actual path; black lateral arrow at heading zero is incompatible with no-slip. B uses normalized time explicitly: actual durations are 9 and .9 seconds, wheel rates remain rad/s. All paths and rates come from the saved held-input states; no wheel torque or traction model.
